text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- U.N. envoy in charge of Western Sahara James Baker starts a North Africa tour from Rabat.
- Morocco and Benin to set up joint economic projects.
- The government prepares the 1997/98 draft budget marked by pressure of budget deficit. Story refers to the draft which will be presented by Prime Minister Abdellatif Filali to parliament in May.
- U.N. envoy James Baker arrives in Morocco.
- Crown Prince Sidi Mohammed to visit Spanish military base of Cordoba in May.
- Government officials and trade unions pursue the social dialogue aimed at improving material and moral conditions of workers.
- ONA Group chairman Fouad Filali calls for close cooperation between Arab economic conglomerates.
- Morocco should count on its own means to upgrade its private enterprises.
- Morocco's phosphate giant Office Cherifien des Phosphates to launch a new commercial strategy.
